page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instructions. Attach a skill to any agent — its text is added to that agent's prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write a skill, import a .md file or a .zip archive, or fetch one from a URL.

placeholder.title: Select a skill
placeholder.body: Pick a skill on the left to open it in the editor.

add.title: Add skill
add.urlHint: A public link to a .md file or a .zip archive, up to 1 MB. GitHub file pages are fetched as raw files.

card.blockedToggle: Blocked — this imported skill did not pass the safety check, so it cannot be enabled.

vetting.title: Safety check

summary.clean: No injection signs found. This skill can be enabled.
summary.suspicious: Looks suspicious, so it is blocked. Edit the text and re-run the check.
summary.malicious: Contains content that tries to hijack the agent. It is blocked and cannot be enabled.
summary.unverified: The model check could not run, so the skill stays blocked. Re-run the check once the model is available.

vetting.notChecked: This imported skill has not been checked yet, so it cannot be enabled.
vetting.stale: The text changed after the last check. Re-run the check to enable it.

import.intro: Upload a .md file or a .zip archive. You review the result before anything is saved.
import.wrongType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists. Pick another name to save.
import.ignoredTitle: Files in the archive that are not processed
import.ignoredNote: Only the skill text is taken from the archive. Scripts and other files are listed here, never read or run.
import.trustWarning: An imported skill is someone else's instructions that will sit inside your agent's prompt. It is saved disabled, and it can be enabled only if it passes the safety check.
import.confirm: I reviewed the text above and want to save it as a disabled skill
import.savedToast: Imported "{name}". It is disabled until the safety check allows enabling it.
import.blockedNote: This skill failed the safety check. You can save it for review, but it cannot be enabled.

editor.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded. It may have been deleted.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It is removed from every agent that uses it. This cannot be undone.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface — the model reads it to decide when to apply the skill. Write it as a directive: when to use it and what to flag.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when reviewing tests. Flag new branches that no test covers.
config.changeNoteHint: Optional. Shown in the version history.

previewTab.injectedHint: This is the exact block the agent sees. It is added in the agent's skill order.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This saves a new version with that text.
versions.restoredToast: Restored v{version} as a new version

agentTab.title: Skills
agentTab.noneAvailable: There are no skills yet. Create one on the Skills page.
agentTab.loadError: Could not load this agent's skills.
